resources.string: Astra Navi Desktop is an open-source, local-first AI desktop companion that keeps files, memory, and screen private on your own hardware.
On the PC, open her Settings and find \"Your other devices\".
This phone has to be on the same home network as the PC.
Already talking to her in this phone\'s browser? Open the menu on her page and choose \"Open it, paired\". That sets this up for you.
That does not look like her address. It is an address on your home network: four numbers with dots, a colon, and a port, like 192.168.1.20:47821.
The PC at %1$s answered with a certificate whose fingerprint ends in
Compare that with the ending shown in her Settings on the PC. Only go on if they match.
A link asks this app to connect to the PC at %1$s, whose certificate fingerprint ends in
Only go on if you just asked for this from her own page, and that ending is the one shown in her Settings on the PC.
This is not the PC you paired with
Something at %1$s answered, but not with her certificate. Nothing was sent to it. If you set her up afresh on the PC, connect again from the start.
Nothing answered at %1$s. Check that the PC is on, that she is running with \"Let my other devices talk to her\" switched on, and that this phone is on the same network.
